forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Circular dependencies hide the real direction of a dependency.

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: Every import must resolve to a file or an installed package.

forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep
forbidden.comment: src/ ships to production; devDependencies are not installed there.

forbidden.name: no-src-alias-in-src
forbidden.comment: The #src alias is for tests only; src/ uses relative imports (ADR-0006).

forbidden.name: domain-only-depends-on-domain
forbidden.comment: A module's domain depends only on its own domain and on shared/domain: no other layers, no packages, no Node APIs.

forbidden.name: application-only-depends-on-domain
forbidden.comment: Use cases depend only on their own domain and application layers and on shared/domain. Adapters plug in through ports.

forbidden.name: infrastructure-not-to-http
forbidden.comment: Driven adapters (infrastructure) and driving adapters (http) do not know each other; the entrypoints wire them.

forbidden.name: http-not-to-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: Driven adapters (infrastructure) and driving adapters (http) do not know each other; the entrypoints wire them.

forbidden.name: shared-not-to-modules
forbidden.comment: shared/ is used by the modules; it never depends on them.

forbidden.name: modules-only-through-index
forbidden.comment: A module reaches another module only through its public index.ts. Only the entrypoints (composition roots) may import module internals.
